fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on utility meter deposits and the hiring of meter testers (including discussion of Florida Power & Light Company), complaints about Miami River conditions and proposals for improvements, and Miami Beach city council politics including selection of a successor to the late Bill Scott. Reports and commentary address restaurant permit applications and health inspections, public health statistics and rumors of epidemics, and traffic enforcement practices (including tail light enforcement and passing on the right). Regular features cover sports and boxing events, University of Miami campus notes, theater and cinema listings, and local business and civic notices.
